To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the prevalence of cognitive impairment and functional disability in elderly people in the city of Bogotá, Colombia was high, (2) the most frequent cognitive and functional impairments were mild and moderate, (3) the prevalence of mild and moderate cognitive and functional impairment was higher in women, and (4) the prevalence of moderate cognitive impairment was higher in subjects with a low educational level and in subjects who were widowed or divorced.
